digestNormalization.rationale: contractDigest is excluded to avoid self-reference; planRevision is bound by the canonical decision itself.
digestNormalization.stalenessRule: REJECT-STALE when the digest of this file differs from the sha256 in the latest non-superseded ADOPTED-CONTRACT decision for this path.

adoptionSource: Operator instruction 2026-10-19 in the Claude Code session: '1. Adopt a contract now', answering the BLOCKED readiness gate on /kbd-apply console-session-auth.
amendmentPolicy: Any change to scope, scenarios or acceptance is a new contract version adopted with kbd-contract-adopt.sh --supersedes <prior decision id> on explicit operator instruction. Dispatching any other change in this phase (lke-agent-settings, phase-integration-gate, promethity-delivery, lke-vector-search) requires an amendment that adds its scenarios and widens tasks.json first. Suggestions and review follow-ups never enter task totals on their own.

releaseClaim.userOperation: The operator opens https://console.prometheusags.ai/webui/, signs in once through Hydra and Kratos at know-me.tools, uses the Web UI in session mode with the agent's identity shown as 'Signed in as', and signs out back to /webui/. No console basic-auth credential exists any more.
supportedEnvironments: LKE cluster 'know-me' (context know-me), namespace ipfs, Envoy Gateway v1.9.1 / Envoy 1.39.1, Argo CD sync from know-me-cluster main
Ory Hydra v26.2.0 at https://oauth.know-me.tools and Kratos login UI v1.3.1 (by digest) in flint-core
A current desktop browser with devtools (operator steps)
releaseClaim.currentCapabilities: Live since know-me-cluster #48 (efeaf57) and the planned ipfs-0 restart at 2026-10-19T21:41Z: SecurityPolicy ipfs/ipfs-webui-auth is Accepted with OIDC, JWT (Authorization: Bearer only), deny-by-default RBAC allowing one subject, and CSRF; basicAuth is gone. ipfs mcp logs auth.oidc on for the session route and fetches JWKS. Unauthenticated checks (console-session.sh unauth, origin-isolation.sh unauth, verify.sh ipfs, the manual bearer probe) passed. The signed-in browser half of 6.7 has not been observed yet. The console 'ui' principal still holds its old credential until 7.1.
explicitUnknowns: Signed-in behaviour (operator steps a, a2, header check, b, b2, c, d, d2, e) is not yet observed.
Whether the access log keeps the id_token_hint query string on the logout URL (follow-up 5, not gating).

scenarioMatrix.name: Unauthenticated console requests are refused or redirected to sign-in
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: know-me-cluster: bash namespaces/ipfs/lke-checks/console-session.sh unauth (read-only, kubectl --context know-me plus curl)
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Every check reports PASS and the script exits 0, including checks 5, 6, 6b and 8: /webui/ answers 302 to Hydra, missing or wrong Origin on state-changing requests answers 403, /auth/session without a session answers 401.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: console-session.sh --self-test: each parser mutation and the two end-to-end mutations must be reported as FAIL (12 of 12 and 2 of 2).
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Live cluster at the image digest above; no credentials, cookies or tokens are read or printed; IPFS_CONSOLE_* variables are not used.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: argv, exit code and full stdout saved to mcp/server/evidence/2026-10-19-console-session-auth-6.7/console-session-unauth.txt (already recorded) plus the self-test output.

scenarioMatrix.name: Session principal allowlist agrees between Envoy RBAC and ipfs mcp
scenarioMatrix.oracle: 25 agreement checks PASS and exit 0 on the merged tree efeaf57.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: --self-test: all 24 mutations (subject added on one side only, extra principal, wildcard) are caught with a nonzero exit.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: know-me-cluster main at efeaf57 (worktree kmc-main5); no cluster writes.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Script outputs recorded in the 6.7 evidence folder, with the tree commit.

scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: kubectl --context know-me -n ipfs get pod ipfs-0 -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[*].imageID}' and the ipfs-mcp container startup log
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Every kubo container imageID ends in sha256:3467dea860aeb097054bdf10391abcada49b48755b3a7bd9c0f585253f952cb6 and the log line shows auth.oidc on with routes session.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: The superseded image 1cfa42a62 (Web UI bafybeif77..., no session mode) must not appear in any container status.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: imageID values and the matching log line in the 6.7 evidence README.

scenarioMatrix.evidence: Quoted Rollback section and PR URL in the 6.7 evidence README.

scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Any open CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM, or a read done in the builder's context, is FAIL.

scenarioMatrix.name: Origin isolation holds without credentials
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: know-me-cluster: bash namespaces/ipfs/lke-checks/origin-isolation.sh unauth (never the default or credentialed mode)
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: A request from Origin https://ipfs.prometheusags.ai to the console API must be refused; if it is allowed the check is FAIL.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Live cluster; IPFS_CONSOLE_USER and IPFS_CONSOLE_PASSWORD are never used by an agent.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: argv, exit code and stdout in the 6.7 evidence folder (already recorded).

scenarioMatrix.name: Gateway refuses a forged bearer with no session
scenarioMatrix.oracle: 401 from Envoy, with no kubo response body.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: The same request through a signed-in browser session returns 200 (operator step); a 200 to the forged bearer is FAIL.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Status code and response headers in the 6.7 evidence README (already recorded).

scenarioMatrix.name: Operator signed-in browser flow
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: Operator browser steps a, a2, header check, b, b2, c, d, d2, e from the 6.7 list in openspec/changes/console-session-auth/tasks.md
scenarioMatrix.oracle: a: sign-in lands on /webui/ showing 'Signed in as'; a2: the five session cookies carry Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite as specified; header check: /webui/ and /api/v0 carry X-Frame-Options: DENY and CSP frame-ancestors 'none'; b: /auth/session from a foreign origin is 403; b2: ?access_token= is ignored (401); c, d, d2, e as written in tasks.md, with d2 recording what happened.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: b and b2 are the negative controls: a 200 on either is FAIL. A sign-in that lands on / instead of /webui/, or a logout with nowhere to go, is FAIL.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Operator's own browser and account; no cookie, token or password values are written down, only names, attributes and status codes.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: Operator's per-step PASS/FAIL with status codes and header names, recorded by the lead in the 6.7 evidence README.

scenarioMatrix.name: Old console credential removed after the soak
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: know-me-cluster PR removing the console ui principal's credential and its token Secret reference; then console-session.sh unauth and the CSA-8 step a
scenarioMatrix.oracle: The merged tree has no credential for the ui principal and no reference to its token Secret; sign-in (step a) still works.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: A request to /auth/session or /mcp with the old bearer token answers 401.
scenarioMatrix.evidence: PR URL, merge SHA, grep of the rendered manifests, and the 401 status code (token value never printed).

scenarioMatrix.name: Residuals M1 and M2 closed in the ADRs
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Each ADR has an appended amendment stating the residual ended, citing the 6.7 evidence path and the 7.1 merge SHA.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: An amendment without the evidence path or merge SHA is FAIL; rewriting earlier ADR text instead of appending is FAIL.

scenarioMatrix.name: Independent reviews of the verifier and of compatibility
scenarioMatrix.productionEntry: security-reviewer read of mcp/server (2.x verifier, jwks.go) and contract 1.2/1.3; reviewer read for /api/v0, gateway, CID and off-switch compatibility
scenarioMatrix.oracle: Both findings files exist with no open CRITICAL or HIGH; 8.2 confirms no /api/v0, gateway or default CID change and an off switch with docs for every new key.
scenarioMatrix.negativeControl: Any open CRITICAL/HIGH, a missing off switch, or a review run in the builder's context is FAIL.
scenarioMatrix.fixtures: kubo feat/ipfs-mcp-server at commit 1140ff10c (the deployed image source).

functionalScope: console-session-auth tasks 6.0b and 6.1 through 8.2: cutover, checks, evidence, credential removal, ADR residuals, reviews

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted scenarios never defer on budget overflow; exhaustion means checkpoint and BLOCKED. Only items listed as deferredOptional may move to a later phase.
deferredOptional: DNS guard check for off-cluster know-me.tools records
Web UI fix for LOW-17 (logout after 15 minutes idle)
verify.sh INFO-G (SKIP instead of FAIL with no Gateway)

exclusions: Other changes of this phase: lke-agent-settings, phase-integration-gate, promethity-delivery, lke-vector-search (need an amendment before dispatch)
agent.origin_allowlist and any write route on the console (prerequisite of lke-agent-settings)
Any change to /api/v0, the HTTP gateway, the default CID recipe or wire behaviour
requiredSafetyChecks: Never print secrets, tokens, cookie values or passwords, including CF_TOKEN and IPFS_CONSOLE_*
Agents run origin-isolation.sh only as 'origin-isolation.sh unauth'
Merges, Argo syncs and pod restarts are operator actions or need explicit operator approval
Reviews run in a separate context from the builder
Keep the old targetRef in any PR that removes a route (2026-10-16 gotcha)
No widening of agent permissions and no routing around classifier denials

budgets.tokenFallback: Stop at the timeMinutes or toolCalls limit, checkpoint, and report BLOCKED with the remaining scenarios.
budgets.exhaustion: Checkpoint and BLOCKED; never a silent PASS. Docs and state may be saved without re-running product checks.

evidenceInvalidation: Evidence is keyed to the image digest, the know-me-cluster tree commit and this contract digest. A new image, a new cluster commit touching ipfs-webui-auth or ipfs-mcp-config, or a contract amendment invalidates only the scenarios that read it; earlier evidence stays in history.
